verdict.rationale: Docs consistently describe creating an account, deploying a GPU Pod from console/API/CLI, and using pre-built templates (PyTorch, JupyterLab) to start executing code almost immediately via SSH, JupyterLab, or VS Code, backed by a full REST API and runpodctl CLI. Community posts corroborate the ease of deployment (e.g., using TheBloke templates in a few clicks) though one older HN comment reports occasional low GPU availability causing slow/failed boots, and the environment can be more locked down than other clouds. Missing for 10: independent, recent hands-on timing benchmarks confirming 'minutes' end-to-end and resolution of the noted availability/lock-down caveats.
